text: This report recommends the approval of those Employee Policies for Exhibition Place detailed in Appendices A and B attached as ones that are new or revised. Most of these revisions were required because of the amendments to the Employment Standards Act, enacted by the Province through Bill 148.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the policies attached as Appendix A and B to the report (May 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place.
